statements.t: “Based on our strong year-to-date results and the continued momentum we see in the business, we are raising our revenue and Adjusted diluted earnings per share outlook for the year.
The Company now expects fiscal 2026 revenue to increase 12% to 13% compared with fiscal 2025, versus its previous guidance range of an 11% to 13% increase.
The Company now expects fiscal 2026 diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) to be in the range of $2.58 to $2.63, compared to its previous guidance range of $2.55 to $2.65.
The Company now expects Adjusted diluted EPS to be in the range of $2.15 to $2.20, up from its previous guidance range of $2.05 to $2.15.
